units: metres, y-up; position = centre of object's base, in parent space; rotation = degrees XYZ

interpretation.summary: Part 2 of 3 of the first full level: an enclosed industrial hall flooded with glowing slime. The round elevator from the Skyforge Arena (part 1) comes down through an opening in the roof and stops on the octagonal central deck (the concept's central tower is removed for it). Four flat bridges to deck platforms against the middle of each wall, four lower square platforms on the diagonals reached by ramps, pipes pouring slime from the corners and walls, a walkway ring along the walls. No open sky: a girder roof with lamp panels closes the hall.
interpretation.scale_basis: No dimensions given. Arena square read as 80 m incl. walls so the 11 m edge platforms and 22 m central deck give third-person combat room; heights from the elevation ratio (fluid -> outer deck ~6 m, central deck ~+1 m, tower ~13 m).
